RunSynchronousCommand.Description: zeta: schedule the GitLab runner bootstrap
RunSynchronousCommand.Path: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$v = Get-Volume | Where-Object { $_.FileSystemLabel -eq 'ZETABOOT' } | Select-Object -First 1; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\ProgramData\zeta | Out-Null; Copy-Item ($v.DriveLetter + ':\bootstrap.ps1') C:\ProgramData\zeta\bootstrap.ps1 -Force; schtasks /create /f /ru SYSTEM /sc onstart /tn zeta-runner-bootstrap /tr 'powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File C:\ProgramData\zeta\bootstrap.ps1'"
